description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Debt Recovery (Special Provision) Act, Notification under Section 30
reasoning: This gazette content contains a notification issued under Section 30 of the Debt Recovery (Special Provisions) Act, No. 02 of 1990, which establishes a new Market Rate of Interest.
